say:1:1511263001:1.text: Well now, isn't this a pleasant turn of the weather? The breeze didn't bring me news of Arden, but it did decide to drop off a much better package. Welcome, Merlin.

say:4:1511263003:1.text: You share Tilaya's story with Granny Dahnie. How, ten millennia ago, she led an exodus of the Wildborn tribe to the Dark Forest.
say:4:1511263003:1.source_cn: 你向达赫妮简单讲述了缇洛亚的事：万年之前，她曾率领众多...

say:5:1511263004:1.text: This means that the Wildborn people may be the ancestors of the people living here today.
say:5:1511263004:1.source_cn: 而这就意味着，雅库伯尔人可能是如今生活在这里之人的先祖。

say:6:1511263005:1.text: Ah, so that's the story of our ancestors...
say:6:1511263005:1.source_cn: 呵、呵，竟然是我们先祖的故事……

say:12:1511263006:0.text: Maybe yes, maybe no. But ten thousand years is a long tide to turn. The Dark Forest is now a tranquil haven where all races have long since learned to blend as one.
say:12:1511263006:0.source_cn: 未必都是，未必不是。过了一万年，薄暮丛林早已是各种种族...
